sourcePolicy: Installable entries must declare package, commit, skill, source, sourceUrl, license, risk, and lastChecked. The helper fetches the exact commit, verifies HEAD and the selected skill, stages an exact native copy, verifies its tree hash and provenance, then activates it without executing fetched repository code or a registry-delivered installer.
immutability: Every installable upstream is pinned to a full Git commit SHA. The recorded Skills CLI version and integrity remain compatibility and discovery metadata; installation uses the repository native-copy helper and does not execute that registry package.
